primaryTextRead.text: Over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite. Over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai.

wikipediaRead.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, A–K
wikipediaRead.locator: Adlai entry in the L–Z/A–K minor-figures article identifies him as father of Shaphat in 1 Chronicles 27:29. It supports kinship, while article’s subject is the father.
